name: email-change-guard
title: Email Change Guard
description: Catches misspelled providers (gmial.con) with a one-tap fix, shows where the confirmation stops matching, spots the same inbox (Gmail dots, +tags), says what moves with the address, and keeps the old address active until the new one is verified, with resend, edit and cancel.

meta.stops: Locked out by a typo'd new email
meta.summary: Catches typos in a new account email and keeps the old address active until the new one is verified, so nobody locks themselves out.
meta.server: Keep the old address active until the new one is verified, notify the old address of the change, and rate-limit resends on the server.
catches: Misspelled email providers, with a one-tap fix
The exact point where the confirmation stops matching
A "new" address that is the same inbox (Gmail dots, +tags)
What moves with the address: sign-in, receipts and 2FA codes
limits: Domain typo detection uses a list of known providers; custom domains aren't checked
Keeping the old address active depends on your backend honouring the pending state
a11y: Focus moves to the confirmation field, the fix, or the pending notice as the flow advances
Fields are described by their hints via aria-describedby
The pending state has a focusable heading
